slides.body:
CEFR B1

O'tmishdagi davomli ish-harakat

Past Perfect Continuous (O'tgan tugallangan davomiy zamon) o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqt yoki boshqa bir voqeadan oldin boshlanib, o'sha paytgacha davom etib turgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

Asosiy Formula:

Subject + had been + Verb-ing

Misol: I had been waiting for two hours before she arrived. (U kelishidan oldin men ikki soat kutgan edim.)
slides.title: Past Perfect Continuous nima?

slides.body:
➕ Darak (Positive)

S + had been + V-ing
They had been playing football. (Ular futbol o'ynashayotgan edi.)

➖ Inkor (Negative)

S + had not (hadn't) been + V-ing
She hadn't been sleeping well. (U yaxshi uxlay olmayotgan edi.)

❓ So'roq (Question)

Had + S + been + V-ing?
Had you been working there for long? (U yerda uzoq vaqt ishlaganmidingiz?)
slides.title: Darak, Inkor va So'roq shakllari
O'tmishdagi voqeadan oldingi davomiylik
slides.body:
Ushbu zamon o'tmishdagi biror nuqtaga qadar davom etgan harakatning davomiyligini (duration) ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ko'pincha for va since ko'rsatkichlari bilan keladi.

Misol:

We had been living in Tashkent for five years before we moved to Samarkand.

Samarqandga ko'chib o'tishimizdan oldin Toshkentda besh yil yashayotgan edik.

slides.title: O'tmishdagi natijaning sababi
slides.body:
O'tmishdagi biror holat yoki natijaning sababini (cause) tushuntirish uchun Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi. Harakat o'sha paytda tugagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uning ta'siri yaqqol ko'rinib turgan bo'ladi.

Misol:

The ground was wet because it had been raining.

Yer ho'l edi, chunki yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi (yomg'ir yog'ib o'tgan, natijasi esa ho'l yer).

Past Continuous

O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan jarayonni ko'rsatadi. Davomiylik muddati muhim emas.

I was running when you called me. (Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda men yugurayotgan edim.)

Past Perfect Continuous

O'tmishdagi boshqa bir voqeadan oldin qancha vaqt davom etganini urg'ulaydi.

I had been running for an hour before you called me. (Siz qo'ng'iroq qilishingizdan oldin bir soat davomida yugurayotgan edim.)
slides.title: Past Perfect Continuous vs. Past Continuous

slides.body:
⚠️ Diqqat qiling!

Harakat bildirmaydigan fe'llar (State Verbs: know, love, like, believe, understand, want, etc.) Continuous zamonlarida ishlatilmaydi. Ularning o'rniga Past Perfect Simple ishlatiladi.

❌ We had been knowing each other for years.

✔️ We had known each other for years. (Biz bir-birimizni ko'p yillardan beri tanir edik.)
slides.title: Harakat bildirmaydigan fe'llar (State Verbs)
Kalit so'zlar (Time Markers)
slides.body:
Past Perfect Continuous zamonini gapda aniqlash va to'g'ri ishlatish uchun quyidagi kalit so'zlarga e'tibor bering:

For... davomida (for 2 hours)
Since... dan beri (since morning)
Before... dan oldin
By the time... bo'lguniga qadar

Misol: By the time the movie ended, it had been raining for three hours.

slides.title: O'zingizni sinab ko'ring!
slides.body:
Quyidagi gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling:

"Ular kelishidan oldin men 3 soat davomida dars tayyorlayotgan edim."

To'g'ri javobni ko'rish

"I had been studying for 3 hours before they arrived."

errors: She has been waiting for hours when he arrived -> She had been waiting for hours when he arrived (O'tgan zamon uchun 'has' emas, 'had' ishlatiladi)
I was working all day before I went home -> I had been working all day before I went home (Davomiylikni ta'kidlash uchun Past Perfect Continuous kerak)
They had been play football for an hour -> They had been playing football for an hour (Fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi shart)
Had you been study English? -> Had you been studying English? (Study fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
He had been sleep for 10 hours -> He had been sleeping for 10 hours (Sleep fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
We have been waiting for him before he called -> We had been waiting for him before he called (O'tgan zamon uchun 'have' emas, 'had' ishlatiladi)
She had been cook dinner for two hours -> She had been cooking dinner for two hours (Cook fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
They had been not working hard -> They had not been working hard (Inkor shaklida 'not' 'had' va 'been' o'rtasida keladi)
I had been read the book for a week -> I had been reading the book for a week (Read fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
How long you had been waiting? -> How long had you been waiting? (Savol shaklida 'had' egadan oldin kelishi kerak)

classroomData.essayPrompt: O'tgan yili o'zingiz erishgan biror maqsad yoki qiziqarli voqea haqida yozing. Masalan, ingliz tilini o'rganishni boshlaganingizda qancha vaqt davomida tayyorgarlik ko'rgan edingiz? Yoki biror sport turi bilan shug'ullangan bo'lsangiz, musobaqadan oldin qancha vaqt mashq qilgan edingiz? Matningizda kamida 8-10 ta gap bo'lishi kerak. Har bir gapda 'Past Perfect Continuous' zamonidan foydalanishga harakat qiling. O'tgan zamondagi harakatlaringizning davomiyligini ko'rsatib bering. Bu sizning o'tgan zamondagi tajribangizni boyitib ko'rsatadi. Matningizni mantiqiy ketma-ketlikda yozing.

They had been playing before it started raining.
How long had you been studying?

classroomData.questionsPrompt: Ustozingizga 'Past Perfect Continuous' mavzusida tushunmagan yoki qiziqtirgan kamida 2 ta savolingizni yozing.

rules.title: Zamon Formulasi
rules.desc: Past Perfect Continuous zamonini hosil qilish uchun ega (Subject) dan so'ng 'had been' va asosiy fe'lga '-ing' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi.
examples: He had been working all day.
They had not been playing long before it started to rain.

rules.desc: Hissiyot, fikrlash yoki egalikni bildiruvchi holat fe'llari (State Verbs) bilan ushbu zamon ishlatilmaydi. Buning o'rniga Past Perfect Simple ishlatiladi.
examples: I had known her for years (NOT: I had been knowing her).
She had owned that car since 2015 (NOT: She had been owning).
rules.title: Harakat va Holat Fe'llari

examples: The road was muddy because it had been raining.
He was tired because he had been running.
rules.desc: O'tmishdagi biror holatning sababini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda harakat o'tmishdagi o'sha nuqtada tugagan bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uning natijasi ko'rinib turgan bo'ladi.
rules.title: O'tmishdagi Sabab-Oqibat

quiz.q: They ___ for over an hour before the bus finally arrived.
quiz.expl: Avtobus kelishidan oldin bir soatdan ortiq davom etgan harakatni ifodalash uchun Past Perfect Continuous (had been waiting) ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Why were you so tired? - I ___ in the garden all morning.
quiz.expl: O'tmishdagi charchoqning (natijaning) sababini ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.
Londonga ko'chib o'tishidan oldin besh yil davomida sodir bo'lgan davomiy harakat Past Perfect Continuous shaklida bo'ladi.
quiz.q: She ___ English for five years before she moved to London.

quiz.expl: O'tmishdagi natijaning (yer ho'lligi) sababini ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.
quiz.q: The ground was wet because it ___.

quiz.expl: 'Know' (bilmoq) holat fe'li (state verb) bo'lgani uchun Continuous shaklida ishlatilmaydi. Shuning uchun Past Perfect Simple to'g'ri.
quiz.q: We ___ each other for years, so we were good friends.
How long ___ before you decided to quit the job?
quiz.expl: Ishdan bo'shash qaroridan oldin qancha vaqt ishlaganini so'rash uchun 'had you been working' so'roq shakli to'g'ri keladi.
Nafasi tiqilib qolganining sababi o'tmishda yugurganidir. Sababni ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.
quiz.q: He was out of breath because he ___.
By the time the teacher arrived, the students ___ for 20 minutes.
quiz.expl: O'qituvchi kelgunga qadar o'quvchilar 20 daqiqa davomida gaplashib turishgan edi. Davomiylikni ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect Continuous mos keladi.

quiz.q: I ___ to call you, but my phone died.
quiz.expl: Telefon o'chib qolishidan oldin sodir bo'layotgan davomiy harakat 'had been trying' orqali ifodalanadi.
O'tmishdagi jahli chiqqan holatning sababi soat 5 dan beri kutayotganligi edi. 'Since' bilan birga Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.
quiz.q: She was angry because she ___ for him since 5 PM.
